project.description: Project name (lowercase, used for AWS resource naming)

uses.description: Optional add-ons this project uses. A coding guideline (rule.md frontmatter `requires:`) or oxlint rule (`meta.requires`) tagged with an add-on is enforced only when that add-on is listed here. The baseline stack (React, Hono, Lambda, Tailwind, modules/ui, e2e) is always assumed — its rules carry no tag.

worktree.description: Worktree id used as a per-checkout namespace (auth cookie prefix, e2e Chrome data dir/port). Override via tss.override.json in each git worktree to run multiple instances side-by-side.

tunnel.description: Start a cloudflared quick tunnel giving the local edge a public URL, passed to the backend as DEV_TUNNEL_URL. For anything off this machine that must call back in (webhook senders, remote sandboxes, a phone on another network). Requires cloudflared on PATH; a missing binary or a failed tunnel warns rather than fails.

githubActionsIamRole.description: Create IAM role for GitHub Actions CI/CD (includes OIDC provider)

bucketSuffix.description: suffix of s3 bucket to avoid duplication

domain.description: Your custom domain (optional). If omitted, the auto-generated CloudFront domain is used and ACM cert / Route53 records are skipped. Requires a Route53 hosted zone when set.

hostedZoneId.description: Route53 hosted zone ID (required only when 'domain' is set)

subdomainMap.description: Subdomain to branch mapping. Use "" for root domain, null to block, { redirect: "target" } for 301 redirect.
